transcript.content: Hello, I am Dr. Smith. Could you please tell me what brings you in to see me today?

Hello, doctor... I'm here because I've been struggling so much lately. Ever since a terrible event a few months ago, these awful, vivid memories of it just keep forcing their way into my head, and I can't make them stop.
I am sorry you are going through this. Could you tell me exactly how many months have passed since this event occurred?
It has been exactly three months since the event happened. It feels like my life completely stopped on that day, and I just can't seem to move past it.
Besides the intrusive memories, do you find yourself actively avoiding places, people, or activities that remind you of the event?

Yes, absolutely. I go completely out of my way to avoid the area where it happened, and I've even stopped seeing certain friends who remind me of that day. Encountering anything related to the event triggers such intense distress that I just can't handle it.
Have you noticed any persistent negative changes in your mood, such as feeling detached from others or having difficulty experiencing positive emotions since the event?

Yes, I feel completely cut off from everyone, even when I'm physically right next to them. Since it happened, it has been incredibly hard to feel close to anyone or to experience any real positive emotions.
Since the event, have you found yourself feeling constantly on edge, easily startled, or having significant trouble with your sleep?

Yes, I'm constantly on edge and jump at any sudden noise or unexpected touch, and it takes me a really long time to calm down. My sleep is also terrible because I struggle to fall asleep, wake up constantly from nightmares, and always feel completely unrefreshed in the morning.
